about: Chatham-Kent is a single-tier municipality in southwestern Ontario, covering a wide rural territory from the Thames River to Lake Erie. The urban centre is Chatham; Wallaceburg, Dresden, Ridgetown, Blenheim, and several lake-shore communities sit across the municipality. Farms, food processing, and Great Lakes shipping shape the local economy. About 104,000 people live in Chatham-Kent.
